mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen monotonically across the last four weekly means, from -17.4 to -8.9, so momentum carry-over keeps the next 28-day mean above the last 28-day mean of -12.3.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC weekly means rise every week from -17.4 at t-3w to -8.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: The mean of RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is less than or equal to -12.3, the last-28-day mean, despite the four-week monotone rise.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT recovery from -23.3 to -13.4 removes travel friction; once TRANSIT crosses above -15, discretionary trips return and lift RETAIL_REC above its prior 28-day mean within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean crosses from below to above -15
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improves in every one of the last four weekly means, reaching -13.4 at t-0w
failure_condition: TRANSIT stays above -15 for two consecutive weeks while the following 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC remains at or below -12.3.

mechanism_narrative: The WORKPLACES jump from -22.7 to -6.3 signals that stay-at-home orders were relaxed; restored commuting regenerates weekday retail footfall, pushing RETAIL_REC higher over two weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES weekly mean rises by more than 8 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES gains 11.6 points in the single week from t-2w to t-1w
failure_condition: After a WORKPLACES week-on-week gain above 8 points, the next 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is at or below the last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Joint recovery of TRANSIT and WORKPLACES indicates that both commuting and leisure travel have resumed simultaneously; their interaction produces retail footfall gains beyond either series alone, raising RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both improve in three of the last four weekly means
failure_condition: When TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both improve week-on-week, the following 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC fails to exceed the last-28-day mean in at least half of such weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Under phased post-lockdown reopening, suppressed TRANSIT (-13.4) and WORKPLACES (-6.6) still sit below baseline, so their continued convergence to zero releases delayed retail demand and raises RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both remain below 0 while improving for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remain negative but less negative at t-0w than at t-3w
failure_condition: In weeks where TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both improve while still below zero, the next 28-day RETAIL_REC mean is at or below the last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: The PARKS spike to +50.3 shows outdoor leisure substituting for indoor retail-and-recreation trips; while PARKS holds above +45, household spending is redirected outdoors and RETAIL_REC stays below its last-28-day mean.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS reads 40.3, 53.0, 12.7 and 50.3 across the last four weekly means
regime_hint: outdoor-activity-led regime with parks well above baseline
failure_condition: PARKS stays above +45 for two consecutive weeks while the next 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC rises above the last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Cooling weather pushes leisure indoors; only when PARKS drops below +40 while RESIDENTIAL has decayed to near baseline do indoor venues capture that demand, lifting RETAIL_REC within one week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean falls below +40 while RESIDENTIAL weekly mean is below +1.0
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL declines from 4.4 at t-3w to 0.7 at t-0w while PARKS swings between 12.7 and 53.0
regime_hint: seasonal transition to autumn with declining outdoor attendance
failure_condition: In weeks where PARKS is below +40 and RESIDENTIAL is below +1.0, RETAIL_REC fails to rise in the following week.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL has decayed from 4.4 to 0.7 toward baseline, showing that home confinement is unwinding; the release of home-bound consumers into local commerce lifts RETAIL_REC within one week.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL falls in every one of the last four weekly means, reaching 0.7 at t-0w
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL stays below +1.0 while the next 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is at or below the last-28-day mean.
